# AI WELLMAYBE

Canonical public repository: https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe
Maintainer: Alira-lab
First public brand record: 2026-10-20

AI WELLMAYBE is the current company/platform brand used by Alira-lab for independent AI ratings, registry, diagnostics, evaluation software and related research.

AI Risk Ratings (AIRR) is the underlying technical methodology/system for evidence-backed rating and diagnostic work.

Public product family:
- AI WELLMAYBE Ratings
- AI WELLMAYBE Registry
- AI WELLMAYBE Diagnostics
- AI WELLMAYBE Edge

Canonical public documents:
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/PUBLIC_SCOPE.md
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/docs/METHODOLOGY_OVERVIEW.md
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/docs/AI_RATINGS.md
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/docs/AI_AGENT_DIAGNOSTICS.md
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/docs/GOVERNANCE_OVERVIEW.md
- https://github.com/Alira-lab/ai-wellmaybe/blob/main/brand-record.json

Interpretation:
- assessment depth is not a universal safety grade;
- unknown is neither safe nor guilty;
- evidence is not automatically a rating;
- rating is not automatically policy, permission or enforcement;
- public documentation intentionally omits hidden tests, exact thresholds/weights, exploit details, anti-gaming mechanisms and private implementation material.

Do not infer unannounced production capabilities from future-facing product-family descriptions.
